title: VIX futures & options November 2026 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the 30-day strip it strikes is a DECEMBER window, not a November one
source: OCC: two Cboe primaries fetched direct and parsed by this event's own initial research on 2026-09-09 — the sanctioned venue for the flip, and it meets verbatim the promotion criterion the seeding proposal set for itself ('re-read the same settlement surface and cite the VX/X6 row'). (1) The machine-readable CSV www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv (HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes, 56 rows) returns `VX,VX/X6,2026-11-18,19.1354`, and the dated query ?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) returns `VX,VX/X6,2026-11-18,18.7688` — two settlement dates, same contract, same expiration. (2) The HTML surface cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/ (302 to /markets/us/futures/market-statistics/settlement/futures/daily; HTTP 200, 537,013 bytes with curl -L) carries `VX/X6` against `2026-11-18` at both 19.1354 and 18.7688 inside its Next.js flight payload. `VXM/X6` (Mini VIX) is listed on both surfaces at both prices. Arithmetic cross-check computed independently this session: 2026-11-18 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2026-12-18, which is December 2026's third Friday, and neither leg is an exchange holiday (Thanksgiving 2026 is 2026-11-26), so Cboe's preceding-business-day displacement clause does not fire. Two Cboe surfaces plus an arithmetic check is the standard that promoted vix-expiration-2026-09-16, -2027-01-20, -2027-02-17 and -2027-03-17; `OCC:` is the prefix market-events-data.ts defines for exactly this ('theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard'). PRIOR SEEDING SOURCE, retained for audit: EST: the same CSV fetched 2026-09-09 by the opex-2026-11-20 pulse-check adjacency sweep, filed estimate purely because that lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. BLOCKED to this runner on 2026-09-09 and therefore NOT relied on: cdn.cboe.com/resources/indices/VRO_History.csv (HTTP 403, AccessDenied) — the realized-settlement history, which is why every historical measurement in this event's ledger is computed from VIX_History.csv (HTTP 200) instead of from VRO prints. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the opex-2026-11-20 pulse check (2026-09-09) as the sharpest hole in the November corridor; canonical file written by this event's own initial research the same day, which read that one proposal first and shadows it. WHAT IT IS: VIX futures and options AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) struck from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out, with the expiring contract ceasing trading 09:00 ET. VX/X6's reference series is therefore 2026-12-18 — December's QUARTERLY expiration (opex-2026-12-18, confirmed, high) — and its measurement window is 2026-11-19 to 2026-12-18. THE CORRECTION THIS RESEARCH MAKES TO ITS OWN PROPOSAL: the proposal led with the crowded 2026-11-18 session (fomc-minutes, APEC, the 20Y bond, housing starts, pending home sales, TIC). Every one of those sits BEFORE the window opens and contributes exactly nothing to what this contract prices. What X6 prices is a December window holding 76 tracked events, 39 of them medium-or-high — including fomc-2026-12-09, cpi-2026-12-10, jobs-2026-12-04, pce-2026-11-25, the 2026-12-11 government-funding deadline, and the 2026-12-18 quad witching that is the SOQ's own reference series. 10 of its 12 high-impact events are in December. The 11-18 crowd is an EXECUTION fact; the December strip is the PRICING fact, and the calendar row's name points at the wrong one. THE MEASURED FINDING, and it is a refusal: this settlement collides with an FOMC MINUTES release at 14:00 ET, a cell no sibling ledger had tested. Built from Cboe's VIX_History.csv (HTTP 200, 9,269 rows, 1990-2026) plus all 176 minutes releases on federalreserve.gov's own calendar pages 2005-2026 (17 pages, all HTTP 200), with settlement dates rule-derived and displaced onto real trading days: on the 51 prior minutes-collision settlements the VIX OPEN GAP averages +0.501% versus -1.338% on the 44 decision-collision settlements — a 1.84-point difference at t = 3.18 (Welch, df 90.9) — while against 165 ordinary settlement mornings (+0.290%) it is indistinguishable (t = 0.43). The pre-Fed morning drift that makes an FOMC-collision settlement distinctive is DECISION-SPECIFIC and does not extend to the minutes. So 2026-11-18 should read as an ordinary settlement morning, and the September sibling's FOMC-morning framing must NOT be carried over to it. Impact LOW and symbols empty: trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex/expiration/witching/settlement/SOQ and return zero hits in both, so no house playbook is expiration- or settlement-keyed. The document's output is one execution guard (nothing trades the 2026-11-18 opening auction), one placement note, and two declined hypotheses. A confirmed date that widens caution about one 30-minute window licenses nothing.
